candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether weak or improving participation persisted across the mixed daily and weekly price paths, rather than relying on isolated proxy snapshots with changing membership.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly say quantitative breadth sequences are absent; daily reviews report point-in-time proxy snapshots with differing membership hashes and no canonical breadth confirmation.
candidates.metric_name: Fixed-universe daily breadth and constituent returns
candidates.missing_history_problem: Prior-day breadth on a consistent universe is not supplied. Snapshot comparisons with different membership cannot establish whether participation deterioration preceded, followed, or persisted through price moves.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would clarify whether spot participation and liquidity conditions deteriorated persistently or were brief, potentially asynchronous snapshots during the observed drawdowns and recoveries.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews describe Binance spot owners as disabled in some captures and otherwise provide brief taker/depth snapshots or differently spanned aggregate windows; weekly reviews identify missing spot-participation sequences.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped spot taker-flow and order-book depth observations
candidates.missing_history_problem: Comparable historical spot-flow and depth observations are not supplied. The available snapshots cannot establish persistence or align microstructure changes with price weakness and recovery.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish sustained or diverging BTC and ETH fund flows from isolated positive or negative sessions when assessing whether flows accompanied weakness or recovery.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews cite isolated latest settled sessions, aged rows, or weekly totals, while noting that intervening flow sequence and timing relative to intraday moves are unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF net flows
candidates.missing_history_problem: A continuous daily sequence aligned to market observations is not supplied; single sessions and weekly aggregates cannot reveal within-period direction or persistence.
